Claimable iff `completed && !claimed && !disputed && !reclaimed`         && `block.timestamp >= completedAt + challengeWindow`.         `challengeWindow == 0` \u21d2 claimable in the same timestamp as completion.      4. Dispute is allowed only by the sponsor or a listed attestor, only while         the mile is completed, not yet disputed, and still inside the window.         Dispute is sticky: no onchain resolution. Disputed miles are never claimable.      5. After `block.timestamp > deadline`, the sponsor may reclaim amounts still         locked on miles that are **not** completed-and-undisputed (i.e. incomplete         or disputed). Completed, undisputed, unclaimed amounts stay with the         beneficiary even if the challenge window has not yet elapsed \u2014 they         become claimable when the window closes (or immediately if window is 0).      6. Completions/attests/disputes do not move tokens. Only `claim` / `reclaim`         / `createCampaign` transfer USDC. attestMilestone(uint256,uint256,string).details: Any-order. Empty evidence is valid. First non-empty URI wins.      After quorum the mile cannot be attested further (`AlreadyCompleted`).

params.evidenceURI: Optional https / ipfs pointer; empty string is valid.

claim(uint256).details: A mile is claimable after its challenge window with no dispute.

params.usdc_: Circle USDC (or MockERC20 in tests). Must be non-zero.

createCampaign(address,address[],uint8,s.details: Caller must `approve` this contract for the total first.      `attestors` is an N-of-M set: each listed address may attest once per mile.      The mile completes when `attestationCount >= quorum`.

params.amounts: USDC base units per mile. Each must be > 0.
params.attestors: Unique set after skipping duplicates. Zero addresses revert.
params.beneficiary: Recipient of completed-mile claims. Not zero.
params.briefURI: Optional https / ipfs pointer to a longer brief.
params.challengeWindow: Seconds after completion during which `dispute` is allowed.        `0` disables the window (claimable immediately — useful for tests and demos).
params.deadline: Unix seconds; must be strictly greater than `block.timestamp`.
params.quorum: Number of distinct attestors required per mile.        Must satisfy `1 <= quorum <= unique(attestors).length`.
params.title: Human title stored onchain.

dispute(uint256,uint256).details: Sticky: there is no onchain resolution. The mile is never claimable afterwards.      After the campaign deadline the sponsor may reclaim its amount.

returns.view_: Read model for the UI. Reverts `CampaignNotFound` if unused.

reclaim(uint256).details: Completed-and-undisputed amounts stay claimable by the beneficiary (after the window).

MAX_ATTESTORS().notice: Upper bound on unique attestors per campaign (bitmap-friendly).

attestMilestone(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Record an attestor vote on a milestone. Completes the mile when quorum is hit.

attestedBy(uint256,uint256).notice: Distinct attestors who have already attested `index`, in attestor-list order.

campaignCount().notice: Next campaign id (also the count of created campaigns).

claim(uint256).notice: Beneficiary withdraws the sum of claimable, unclaimed milestones.

claimableAmount(uint256).notice: Sum of completed, undisputed, unclaimed milestone amounts whose window elapsed.

createCampaign(address,address[],uint8,s.notice: Create a campaign and pull `sum(amounts)` USDC from the sponsor.

dispute(uint256,uint256).notice: Sponsor or any listed attestor disputes a completed mile during its window.

getAttestors(uint256).notice: Attestor set in insert order (duplicates omitted at create).

getCampaign(uint256).notice: Packed campaign view including live claimable / reclaimable.

getMilestones(uint256).notice: All milestones for a campaign, index-stable.

hasAttested(uint256,uint256,address).notice: campaignId => mile index => attestor => already attested.

hasAttestedAll(uint256,address).notice: Whether `account` has already attested each mile. Parallel to `getMilestones`.

isAttestor(uint256,address).notice: campaignId => account => whether the account may attest miles.

reclaim(uint256).notice: After the deadline, sponsor pulls USDC still locked on incomplete or disputed miles.

reclaimableAmount(uint256).notice: Sum still locked on incomplete or disputed miles if the deadline has passed; else 0.
